description: Read the plans that add pages to the daily monitor: price in USD, pages, 30 days and no automatic renewal. With a signed-in account, also read its active plan and how many monitored pages are free, paid, used and available. A person buys a plan on the pricing page. Each plan adds pages to the daily monitor of the account for 30 days. Purchases add up while they are valid. There is no automatic renewal. Without a session, `account` is `null`.
name: list_plans
title: List plans
